ukmt-pink-2016-07.title: Lower bound and example
ukmt-pink-2016-07.body:
The letter M must pass T, E and A (3 swaps) and A must pass T and E (2 more): at least 5 swaps. TEAM, TEMA, TMEA, MTEA, MTAE, MATE uses exactly 5.

**Answer: (C) 5**

ukmt-pink-2016-23.title: Place people around the table
ukmt-pink-2016-23.body:
Put Andrea at the top. Eva and Filip sit next to each other, so Ben is beside Andrea; since Ben is opposite the speed skater and the skier is on Andrea's left, Ben is on her left and is the skier. The hockey player has a woman to the left, so the hockey player sits at the bottom, and Eva sits on the left side opposite Ben... Eva is the speed skater.

**Answer: (A) speed skating**
